Ashlina is named after the revered Goddess of the Night, emphasizing the importance of darkness and the mysteries it holds in Indian culture.

Shakti is believed to be the source of all creation, and the name Ashlina highlights the reverence and connection to this powerful force. By carrying the name Ashlina, one can embody the spiritual strength and courage associated with the Goddess of the Night, embodiment of peace, tranquility, and the gates to spiritual enlightenment.
